decisions.reason: Its disappearance from the website after 2023 suggests the standalone GA4 plugin did not justify continued market attention, and with limited evidence of traction the firm should reallocate resources to stronger offerings.
A Universal Analytics plugin has little remaining option value because the underlying standard became obsolete, so keeping it on the market would tie up resources with minimal upside.
Since the retail system interface plugin was only mentioned in 2023 and then vanished, the results likely revealed too little demand or too much customization cost to warrant further commitment.

The relaunch SEO support service kept its own page in both 2023 and 2024, indicating sustained relevance and a good strategic fit with the firm's established e-commerce and performance-marketing capabilities.
The SEO workshops were newly introduced in 2024 and still have unresolved upside with relatively low continuation cost, so the firm should keep this option open for another period.
